categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Longda Superalloy Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, production, and sales of high-temperature superalloys and alloy materials. Its main product lines include cast high-temperature superalloys, wrought high-temperature superalloys, nickel-based corrosion-resistant alloys, and alloy tubing products such as copper-nickel alloy tubes and high-speed rail grounding alloy tubes. These products serve key industries including aerospace, gas turbines, energy power, petrochemicals, shipbuilding, and automotive turbochargers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced metallurgical technologies including vacuum induction melting, electroslag remelting, vacuum consumable electrode remelting, and multi-stage homogenization treatments. It has mastered the triple melting process for wrought superalloys and developed proprietary technologies for ultra-high purity alloy melting, low segregation casting, and fine-grain forging. The company also has a standardized testing system certified by CNAS and NADCAP, enabling precise chemical composition and mechanical property control. It actively develops recycling technologies for returned materials and applies digital intelligent manufacturing systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in the aerospace and gas turbine sectors, including domestic and international manufacturers of aircraft engines and heavy-duty gas turbines. The company also serves petrochemical, energy power, shipbuilding, rail transit, and automotive industries. Its products are used in critical components such as turbine blades, combustion chambers, turbine disks, compressor disks, and casings. The company has established long-term supply agreements with major global aerospace engine manufacturers like Rolls-Royce and Safran.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province. It has expanded its international presence with subsidiaries and production bases in Singapore and Malaysia, aiming to integrate global resources and serve international markets. Overseas sales have grown significantly, accounting for a substantial portion of revenue, with active market development in Asia-Pacific and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Longda operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the production of high-performance alloy materials and superalloy ingots and billets. It supplies these critical raw materials to downstream manufacturers of aerospace engines, gas turbines, and other high-end equipment. The company also engages in alloy tube manufacturing serving various industrial applications, positioning itself as a key materials supplier within strategic industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on developing new alloy grades, improving purity and uniformity, and enhancing production processes. It collaborates with national laboratories and research institutes, including a joint laboratory with Suzhou Laboratory, and operates a national postdoctoral research station. Key R&D projects target low-rhenium single-crystal superalloys, recycling of returned materials, and advanced wrought superalloys for next-generation aerospace engines. Digital transformation and smart factory initiatives are also strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of alloy products including high-temperature superalloys, corrosion-resistant alloys, and alloy tubing. The company employs a combination of direct sales and distributor channels. Sales contracts are recognized upon transfer of control, typically at delivery or upon customs clearance for exports. The company also receives government subsidies and project-based funding that supplement operating income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Longda is positioned as a leading domestic high-temperature superalloy manufacturer with capabilities in both cast and wrought superalloys, holding a leading position in China’s aerospace materials sector. It competes with other domestic and international superalloy producers but distinguishes itself through advanced technology, comprehensive product lines, and integration into the national aerospace and gas turbine supply chains. The company is recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'little giant' enterprise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.39 billion, a 15.22% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 66.1 million, up 19.38%. Total assets reached RMB 3.57 billion, growing 6.33% from the prior year. The company has demonstrated steady growth driven by increased sales in aerospace and gas turbine sectors, with significant expansion in overseas markets. R&D investment accounted for 4.28% of revenue, supporting sustained innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Longda emphasizes high purity, uniformity, and stability of its superalloy products, supported by advanced melting and testing technologies. Its ability to produce both cast and wrought aerospace-grade superalloys, including single-crystal alloys, differentiates it in the market. The company offers integrated solutions from alloy ingots to finished components, with strong quality assurance and certification credentials. Its strategic partnerships with leading aerospace and energy companies and commitment to innovation provide customers with reliable, high-performance materials critical for demanding applications.
